description: This file implements socket communication utilities for client-server interactions, including socket creation, data transmission, and byte order handling within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Represents a client-side socket connection, providing methods for receiving and sending data.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Represents a server-side socket that listens for incoming client connections.

methods.name: ClientSocket::RecvAny
methods.description: Receives any data up to the specified length from the socket.

methods.name: ClientSocket::closed
methods.description: Checks if the socket connection has been closed.

methods.name: ClientSocket::Recv
methods.description: Receives exactly the specified amount of data from the socket.

methods.name: ClientSocket::SendNoSignal
methods.description: Sends data over the socket without generating a SIGPIPE signal.
